2609.23986.name: Jev-Mem
2609.23986.what: System-One controller handles memory typing, routing, graph traversal, candidate scoring; System-Two LLM invoked only for complex reasoning and synthesis.
2609.23986.learns_what: nothing; fixed System-One controller rules for routing, scoring, graph traversal
2609.23986.unique: System-One controller handles routing, scoring and traversal; System-Two LLM invoked only for complex synthesis.

2609.02750.name: SRMA
2609.02750.what: Reflection edits are accepted into semantic memory only after a grounded evaluation risk strictly decreases, under an orchestrator-worker coordination game.
2609.02750.fit: Mainly a game-theoretic/information-theoretic account of multi-agent reflection and coordination, not a classic memory store; closest existing family is experience.
2609.02750.learns_what: reflection edits accepted into semantic memory after grounded risk decreases
2609.02750.unique: Accepts memory edits only when grounded evaluation risk strictly decreases, with proven convergence rate guarantees.

2608.23920.name: Wontopos (Tablet 2)
2608.23920.what: Production long-term memory engine using dense retrieval only (no lexical matching) over text and captionless photographs, evaluated on LongMemEval-S and BEAM-1M.
2608.23920.unique: Production long-term memory engine using dense retrieval only (no lexical matching) over text and captionless photographs, evaluated on LongMemEval-S and

2608.10676.name: ReTree

2608.10676.learns_what: nothing; fixed backtracking/revision rules over an evidence tree within one task
2608.10676.unique: Evidence tree tracks per-node summaries and revision histories; contradictions trigger backtracking, evidence replacement, and branch pruning.

2608.26005.name: VoiceMem
2608.26005.what: Parallel informational left-brain and emotional right-brain memory with streaming I/O; top-k retrieval plus dual-node persona modeling for affect.
2608.26005.learns_what: speech LM trained for streaming memory-aware retrieval and persona modeling
2608.26005.unique: Parallel informational left-brain and emotional right-brain memory with streaming I/O for real-time speech agents.

2608.28460.name: LayerRecall
2608.28460.what: Retrieves relevant historical K/V states and injects them only into memory-sensitive video-DiT layers to recover reappearing subjects/attributes in long video generation.
2608.28460.learns_what: layer-selective KV memory router trained via prediction-space supervision (CHPM)
2608.28460.unique: Layer-selective router injects retrieved historical KV only into memory-sensitive video-DiT layers, trained via prediction-space supervision (CHPM).

2608.15669.name: Large Discovery Model (LDM)
2608.15669.what: Generative model proposes/refines candidates; a Bayesian non-parametric surrogate predicts performance and uncertainty; discovery memory is continually updated from new observations.
2608.15669.fit: Borderline case: a Bayesian surrogate model over accumulated experimental observations for scientific search, not a classic LLM agent memory system.
2608.15669.learns_what: Bayesian surrogate reward model and discovery memory continually updated from observations
2608.15669.unique: Couples generative proposal/refinement with a Bayesian non-parametric surrogate continually updating discovery memory from observations.

2608.24876.name: Recuris
2608.24876.what: Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory; a Meta-Agent makes validation-gated updates to Skill Memory from execution evidence.
2608.24876.learns_what: skill memory updated by a Meta-Agent from validation-gated execution evidence
2608.24876.unique: Working Memory guides skill selection while a fixed Meta-Agent makes validation-gated updates to Skill Memory.

2607.18975.name: Mi-Memory
2607.18975.what: Lifecycle memory framework (Structure/Expansion/Evolution/Deployment) instantiated via MemStack, MemSense/MemFuse, D2ACCI/E2MEND and LiteMem modules with an audit-contract artifact chain.
2607.18975.unique: Lifecycle memory framework (Structure/Expansion/Evolution/Deployment) instantiated via MemStack, MemSense/MemFuse, D2ACCI/E2MEND and LiteMem modules with an audit-contract artifact chain.

2607.25380.name: Memory for Large Language Models
2607.25380.what: Architecture-centric taxonomy of LLM memory along representation (implicit/explicit), update dynamics (offline/online) and persistence (short/long-term) axes.
2607.25380.unique: Formalizes memory along representation, update dynamics and persistence, plus writing/routing/consolidation mechanisms.

2607.01224.name: AutoMem
2607.01224.what: File-system operations become first-class memory actions; an LLM revises memory structure/schema, and RL sharpens the model's own memory-decision proficiency.
2607.01224.fit: Blends prompt/schema optimization of a file-based memory with weight-level RL training of memory proficiency; could sit under experience or internalize.
2607.01224.learns_what: model's own memory-management (file-system) actions sharpened via RL from good decisions
2607.01224.unique: LLM reviews trajectories to revise memory file-schema/prompts while RL sharpens the model's own memory-decision proficiency.

2607.06678.name: NativeMEM
2607.06678.what: The VLA's own vision encoder compresses each historical camera frame into a single token appended to the input sequence for long-horizon manipulation.
2607.06678.learns_what: vision-encoder memory tokenizer and VLA fine-tuned on compressed frame-history tokens
2607.06678.unique: Repurposes the VLA's own vision encoder to compress each historical frame into one token appended to the input sequence.

2607.26760.name: Metis
2607.26760.what: A native memory state inside the backbone is compressed via memory attention and updated gradient-free through a forward pass, while weights stay frozen.
2607.26760.learns_what: native memory state and its attention/update procedures learned during mid-training
2607.26760.unique: Native memory state updated gradient-free via a single forward pass while backbone weights stay frozen.

2607.14777.name: SEED
2607.14777.what: Policy is fine-tuned to write natural-language hindsight skills from trajectories; the skill-induced probability shift is distilled token-level back into the policy via RL.
2607.14777.learns_what: policy trained via RL plus distillation to write and use hindsight skills
2607.14777.unique: Distills the probability shift induced by self-written hindsight skills into the policy token-by-token.

2607.26017.name: UniMem
2607.26017.what: Learnable routing tokens route novel/sparse tasks to an episodic retrieval buffer and consolidate recurring patterns into expandable parametric memory blocks.
2607.26017.learns_what: routing tokens and expandable parametric memory blocks trained to consolidate recurring patterns
2607.26017.unique: Learnable routing tokens split novel tasks to episodic buffer vs consolidating recurring patterns into parametric blocks.

2606.12329.name: projectmem
2606.12329.what: Append-only plain-text log of typed events (issues, attempts, fixes, decisions) projected into AI-readable summaries served via MCP; a pre-action gate warns of repeated failures.
2606.12329.unique: Append-only plain-text log of typed events (issues, attempts, fixes, decisions) projected into AI-readable summaries served via MCP; a pre-action gate

2606.24775.name: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
2606.24775.what: Decomposes agent memory into representation/storage, extraction, retrieval/routing and maintenance modules; evaluates 12 memory systems across 5 benchmark workloads and 11 datasets.
2606.24775.unique: Decomposes memory into representation, extraction, retrieval/routing, maintenance; ablates 12 systems across 11 datasets.

2606.00793.name: MBench
2606.00793.what: Decomposes video world-model memory into entity, environment and causal consistency across 12 sub-dimensions, scored by rule-based metrics and a VLM judge.
2606.00793.unique: Decomposes memory into entity, environment and causal consistency across 12 sub-dimensions scored by rule-based+VLM judge.

2606.17546.name: SEAGym
2606.17546.what: Turns benchmarks into dynamic self-evolution task sources with train/held-out/replay splits to measure whether agent harness updates (incl. memory) generalize or overfit.

2606.14571.name: StreamMemBench
2606.14571.what: Two-step tasks built around EgoLife egocentric-stream evidence anchors; four metrics diagnose evidence recall, evidence use, feedback incorporation, and follow-up reuse.
2606.14571.unique: Two-step tasks anchored on EgoLife evidence; four metrics diagnose recall, use, feedback incorporation and follow-up reuse.

2606.29778.name: Mandol
2606.29778.what: Basic and abstract memory layers unified as SemanticMap+SemanticGraph fusing key-value, vector and graph structures, with query-adaptive routing needing no LLM calls at retrieval.
2606.29778.learns_what: nothing; fixed agglomerative graph construction and quantitative query rules
2606.29778.unique: Fuses key-value, vector and graph in one SemanticMap+SemanticGraph, retrieving via query-adaptive routing with no LLM calls.

2606.15405.name: T-Mem
2606.15405.what: Write-time 'trigger' rehearsals give each memory both a descriptive and an associative retrieval path, at single-fact and full-exchange granularities.
2606.15405.learns_what: nothing; fixed write-time descriptive/associative trigger generation rules
2606.15405.unique: Write-time descriptive and associative 'trigger' rehearsals at both single-fact and full-exchange granularity for latent recall.

2606.19926.name: MemGUI-Agent
2606.19926.what: Context-as-Action policy emits context-management actions that maintain folded action history, folded UI state, and a recent step record instead of appending full history.
2606.19926.learns_what: policy fine-tuned on annotated context-management (ConAct) trajectories
2606.19926.unique: Context-as-Action policy maintains three structured fields -- folded action history, folded UI state, recent step record -- for mobile GUI agents.

2606.17162.name: MemSlides
2606.17162.what: Separates user-profile memory (persona), working memory (session constraints), and tool memory (reusable edit experience) to drive scoped slide-local revisions.
2606.17162.learns_what: nothing; fixed hierarchical split of profile/working/tool memory for personalization
2606.17162.unique: Separates profile, working, and tool memory to drive scoped slide-local revisions instead of full deck regeneration.

2606.03979.name: Sleep
2606.03979.what: Sleep phase distills short-term context into long-term parameters via upward Knowledge Seeding distillation; Dreaming phase self-improves via an RL-generated synthetic curriculum.
2606.03979.learns_what: long-term parameters updated via distillation (Knowledge Seeding) and RL-driven synthetic replay
2606.03979.unique: Sleep phase distills short-term context into long-term weights; Dreaming phase rehearses an RL-generated synthetic curriculum.

2606.06473.name: MLEvolve
2606.06473.what: Retrospective Memory combines a cold-start knowledge base with a dynamic global memory for task-specific experience retrieval and reuse during tree-search algorithm discovery.
2606.06473.learns_what: cold-start plus dynamic global memory of task-specific experience reused across search
2606.06473.unique: Retrospective Memory combines a cold-start knowledge base with dynamic memory reused across Progressive MCGS tree search.

2606.03108.name: EvoTrainer
2606.03108.what: Diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills to co-evolve the policy and its training harness.
2606.03108.fit: Primarily about co-evolving an RL training harness with policy weights; the 'reusable skills' component is the only clear memory-family fit (experience).
2606.03108.learns_what: RL-trained policy alongside an evolving training harness with accumulated reusable skills
2606.03108.unique: Diagnoses rollout-level evidence and backtests interventions to co-evolve the RL policy and its training harness.

2606.17016.name: TokenPilot
2606.17016.what: Ingestion-Aware Compaction stabilizes prompt prefixes for cache continuity; Lifecycle-Aware Eviction offloads context segments by residual utility on a batch-turn schedule.
2606.17016.learns_what: nothing; fixed prefix-stabilizing compaction and residual-utility eviction schedule
2606.17016.unique: Ingestion-Aware Compaction stabilizes prompt prefixes for cache continuity; Lifecycle-Aware Eviction offloads segments by residual utility.

2606.09498.name: Self-Harness
2606.09498.what: Weakness Mining finds model-specific failure patterns from execution traces; Harness Proposal edits the harness; edits kept only after regression-test validation.
2606.09498.learns_what: agent harness code edited from mined failure patterns, kept after regression testing

2606.04329.name: MPBench
2606.04329.what: Identifies four memory write channels and nine structural vulnerabilities, builds a taxonomy of six memory-poisoning attack classes, and introduces MPBench for evaluation.
2606.04329.unique: Identifies four memory write channels, nine vulnerabilities and six attack classes; introduces MPBench for evaluation.

2605.29640.name: VikingMem
2605.29640.what: Event-centric extraction and entity abstraction with topic-wise timeline temporal compression and time-weighted recall, implemented on the VikingDB vector engine.
2605.29640.unique: Event-centric extraction and entity abstraction with topic-wise timeline temporal compression and time-weighted recall, implemented on the VikingDB vector engine.

2605.06716.name: From Storage to Experience
2605.06716.what: Formalizes three evolutionary stages of agent memory: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement) and Experience (trajectory abstraction).
2605.06716.unique: Formalizes three evolutionary stages, Storage, Reflection, Experience, driven by continual-learning goals.

2605.10921.name: RoboMemArena
2605.10921.what: 26 robotic tasks (avg 1000+ steps, 68.9% memory-dependent) with VLM-generated subtasks and keyframe annotations, plus paired real-world evaluation.
2605.10921.unique: 26 tasks with VLM-generated subtasks and keyframes; PrediMem uses a predictive coding head over recent/keyframe buffers.

2605.31086.name: RHELM
2605.31086.what: A LOOP module generates realistic, evolving dialogues integrated with heterogeneous sources (documents, emails); QA pairs mapped to 27 memory characteristics.
2605.31086.unique: LOOP module generates evolving dialogues integrated with heterogeneous documents/emails across 27 memory characteristics.

2605.16045.name: RecMem
2605.16045.what: Interactions sit in a lightweight-embedding subconscious layer; an LLM only extracts and consolidates episodic/semantic memory once recurring semantic clusters are observed.
2605.16045.learns_what: nothing; fixed recurrence-triggered consolidation into episodic/semantic memory
2605.16045.unique: Consolidates episodic/semantic memory only after sustained recurrence of similar interactions, cutting extraction token cost up to 87%.

2605.09530.name: MemPrivacy
2605.09530.what: An edge-side model identifies privacy-sensitive spans, replaces them with type-aware placeholders for cloud-side memory processing, and restores values locally when needed.
2605.09530.learns_what: edge model trained to detect privacy-sensitive spans and produce type-aware placeholders
2605.09530.unique: Edge model masks privacy-sensitive spans with type-aware placeholders, restoring values locally to preserve memory utility.

2605.11325.name: Tenure
2605.11325.what: A structured belief-store proxy resolves scope and retrieval before inference and injects typed belief state as ambient instruction, bypassing similarity search.
2605.11325.learns_what: nothing; fixed belief-store proxy resolves scope/retrieval before inference
2605.11325.unique: Structured belief-store proxy resolves scope/retrieval before inference, injecting typed belief state, bypassing similarity search.

2605.07594.name: MemCompiler
2605.07594.what: A learned Memory Compiler reads a structured Brief State and compiles relevant memory into guidance via a text channel plus a latent Soft-Mem channel for perceptual info.
2605.07594.learns_what: Memory Compiler model trained to select/compile relevant memory from execution state
2605.07594.unique: Learned Memory Compiler reads a structured Brief State and compiles guidance via text plus a latent Soft-Mem channel.

2605.28773.name: FluxMem
2605.28773.what: Heterogeneous graph memory is refined through connection formation, feedback-driven refinement and consolidation, distilling recurrent successful trajectories into reusable procedural circuits.
2605.28773.learns_what: graph topology refined and procedural circuits distilled from recurrent successful trajectories
2605.28773.unique: Distills recurrent successful trajectories into reusable procedural circuits via connectivity-evolving graph refinement.

2605.12061.name: SAGE
2605.12061.what: A memory writer incrementally builds structured graph memory from interactions; a Graph Foundation Model-based reader retrieves and feeds evolution signal back to the writer.
2605.12061.learns_what: Graph Foundation Model memory reader trained with writer feedback to improve retrieval
2605.12061.unique: Graph Foundation Model reader retrieves and feeds evolution feedback back to the memory writer.

2605.16883.name: SE-GA
2605.16883.what: Test-Time Memory Extension retrieves episodic, semantic and experiential memories at inference; a training pipeline (MASE) then fine-tunes the policy on TTME-collected data.
2605.16883.learns_what: foundational GUI policy fine-tuned on data collected via test-time memory retrieval
2605.16883.unique: Fine-tunes the GUI policy (MASE) on data collected via test-time retrieval of episodic, semantic, experiential memories.

2605.16481.name: Visual Agentic Memory (VAM)
2605.16481.what: Online Indexing selectively retains streaming visual evidence; Hierarchical Memory aligns temporal and spatial context; Agentic Retrieval searches and verifies evidence before answering.
2605.16481.learns_what: nothing; training-free online indexing and agentic retrieval of video evidence
2605.16481.unique: Agentic Retrieval searches, inspects and verifies evidence before answering, grounding in recoverable observations not compressed latents.

2605.12357.name: δ-mem
2605.12357.what: A fixed-size state matrix updated online via a delta rule compresses past information; its readout generates low-rank corrections to a frozen backbone's attention.
2605.12357.learns_what: online delta-rule memory state producing attention corrections, trained end-to-end
2605.12357.unique: Fixed 8x8 state matrix updated via a delta rule; its readout gives low-rank corrections to frozen attention.

2605.15156.name: MeMo
2605.15156.what: New knowledge is encoded into a separate trainable memory model while the base LLM's weights, logits and internals remain untouched.
2605.15156.learns_what: separate memory model trained to encode new knowledge while base LLM stays frozen
2605.15156.unique: Encodes new knowledge into a separate trainable memory model while base LLM weights/logits stay frozen.

2605.26099.name: Offline Recurrence Sleep
2605.26099.what: A periodic sleep phase runs N offline recurrent passes converting recent context into persistent SSM fast weights via a learned local rule, then clears the KV cache.
2605.26099.learns_what: SSM fast-weight state updated by a learned local rule during periodic sleep passes
2605.26099.unique: Periodic sleep phase runs N offline recurrent passes converting context into SSM fast weights, then clears the KV cache.

2605.05971.name: KV-CAT
2605.05971.what: Continued pretraining with train-time KV-slot masking pushes representations toward compressibility so post-hoc KV cache compression methods perform better.
2605.05971.learns_what: continued pretraining pushes representations toward KV-cache compressibility
2605.05971.unique: Continued pretraining with train-time KV-slot masking makes representations more compressible for post-hoc compression methods.

2605.23904.name: SkillOpt
2605.23904.what: An optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace text edits on a single skill document, accepted only when a held-out score strictly improves.
2605.23904.learns_what: skill document text edited via optimizer-scored add/delete/replace, gated by validation score
2605.23904.unique: An optimizer model applies bounded add/delete/replace edits to a skill document, accepted only if held-out score improves.

2605.12484.name: Fast-Slow Training (FST)
2605.12484.what: Model parameters act as slow weights trained via RL, while an optimized in-context prompt acts as fast weights updated from textual feedback.
2605.12484.fit: A general continual-learning framework blending weight updates and context optimization, not a dedicated fact/experience memory store.
2605.12484.learns_what: slow model weights trained via RL; fast in-context weights updated from textual feedback
2605.12484.unique: Slow RL-trained weights plus fast in-context weights updated from textual feedback, reducing forgetting.

2605.06702.name: CASCADE
2605.06702.what: Maintains an explicit, evolving episodic memory of cases; experience reuse is formulated as a contextual bandit that selects and refines task-relevant cases.
2605.06702.learns_what: episodic case memory selected and refined via a contextual bandit, no weight updates
2605.06702.unique: Formulates episodic case reuse as a contextual bandit with proven no-regret exploration-exploitation guarantees.

2605.22721.name: DecentMem
2605.22721.what: Each agent keeps a dual-pool memory: an exploitation pool of consolidated trajectories and an exploration pool of generated candidates, reweighted by LLM-judge feedback.
2605.22721.learns_what: dual-pool trajectory memory reweighted online via LLM-judge feedback
2605.22721.unique: Each agent keeps its own dual exploitation/exploration trajectory pools reweighted online by an LLM-as-judge.

2605.30159.name: MMPO
2605.30159.what: Recursive trajectory summarization into compact memory is trained via RL using a Belief Entropy proxy that penalizes summaries which raise uncertainty about latent task state.
2605.30159.learns_what: memory-summarization policy trained via RL with a Belief-Entropy penalty
2605.30159.unique: Trains recursive trajectory summarization via RL using a Belief Entropy proxy that penalizes summaries raising uncertainty about task state.

2605.21463.name: Mem-π
2605.21463.what: A separate parametric model, conditioned on the agent's current context, decides when and what guidance to generate, trained with decision-content decoupled RL.
2605.21463.learns_what: guidance-generation model trained via RL to decide when/what memory to generate
2605.21463.unique: Dedicated model decides when and what guidance to generate, trained with decision-content decoupled RL.

2605.12978.name: Episodic vs Consolidated Memory
2605.12978.what: Compares raw episodic trajectory retention against LLM-rewritten consolidated memory in a controlled Retain/Delete/Consolidate environment (ARC-AGI Stream); consolidation degrades accuracy.
2605.12978.learns_what: nothing; compares raw episodic retention against prompted-LLM consolidation
2605.12978.unique: Controlled Retain/Delete/Consolidate ARC-AGI environment shows LLM-rewritten consolidation degrades below no-memory baseline.

2605.03675.name: MEMTIER
2605.03675.what: Episodic JSONL store, a five-signal weighted retrieval engine, and a consolidation daemon that promotes episodic facts to a semantic tier, with PPO-tuned retrieval weights.
2605.03675.learns_what: retrieval-weighting policy trained via PPO over five retrieval signals
2605.03675.unique: Five-signal weighted retrieval engine with PPO-tuned weights, plus an async daemon promoting episodic facts to a semantic tier.

2605.18747.name: Code as Agent Harness
2605.18747.what: Reviews code as the operational substrate for agent reasoning, planning, memory and tool use across harness interface, mechanisms, and multi-agent scaling layers.
2605.18747.fit: A broad survey of agent harness engineering in which memory is only one of three discussed layers, not the paper's sole focus.
2605.18747.unique: Frames code itself as the operational substrate for agent reasoning, memory and multi-agent coordination.

2605.15184.name: Is Grep All You Need?
2605.15184.what: Compares grep vs vector retrieval across agent harnesses (Chronos, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) on a LongMemEval subset, with inline vs file-based tool outputs.
2605.15184.unique: Compares grep vs vector retrieval across four agent harnesses on a LongMemEval subset with inline vs file-based outputs.

2604.01599.name: ByteRover
2604.01599.what: The same LLM curates and retrieves knowledge into a file-based hierarchical Context Tree (Domain/Topic/Subtopic/Entry) with importance/maturity/recency scoring and 5-tier progressive retrieval.
2604.01599.learns_what: nothing; fixed context-tree importance/maturity/recency scoring and tiered retrieval
2604.01599.unique: Same LLM curates and retrieves via a 5-tier progressive strategy resolving most queries under 100ms without LLM calls.

2604.22085.name: Memanto
2604.22085.what: A typed semantic memory schema (13 categories) with automated conflict resolution and temporal versioning, served by a no-indexing semantic search engine (Moorcheh).
2604.22085.unique: A typed semantic memory schema (13 categories) with automated conflict resolution and temporal versioning, served by a no-indexing semantic search

2604.23878.name: ZenBrain
2604.23878.what: Seven-layer neuroscience-derived architecture unifying 15 mechanisms (two-factor synaptic consolidation, a sleep-like simulation-selection loop, decay) under one MemoryCoordinator.
2604.23878.unique: Seven-layer neuroscience-derived architecture unifying 15 mechanisms (two-factor synaptic consolidation, a sleep-like simulation-selection loop, decay) under one MemoryCoordinator.

2604.01707.name: Memory in the LLM Era
2604.01707.what: Unifies representative agent memory methods into one framework and empirically compares them on conversational and agentic memory benchmarks.
2604.01707.unique: Unifies memory methods into one framework, empirically compares them, and designs a new best-performing method.

2604.08224.name: Externalization in LLM Agents
2604.08224.what: Reviews memory, skills, protocols and harness engineering as coupled forms of externalizing agent capability outside model weights.
2604.08224.unique: Treats memory, skills and protocols as coupled forms of externalization unified by harness engineering.

2604.13074.name: Persona-MME
2604.13074.what: PersonaVLM extracts/summarizes chronological multimodal memories into a personalized database, retrieves them for multi-turn reasoning, and aligns outputs to inferred personality; benchmark spans 2000+ cases.
2604.13074.unique: PersonaVLM extracts chronological multimodal memories into a database and aligns outputs to inferred personality.

2604.21748.name: StructMem
2604.21748.what: Temporally anchors dual perspectives on events and performs periodic semantic consolidation, inducing cross-event connections beyond a flat memory store.
2604.21748.learns_what: nothing; fixed dual-perspective temporal anchoring and periodic consolidation
2604.21748.unique: Temporally anchors dual perspectives on each event and periodically consolidates them to induce cross-event connections.

2604.17265.name: MemSearch-o1
2604.17265.what: Memory fragments grow from query seed tokens, are retraced and refined via a contribution function, and reorganized into a globally connected memory path.
2604.17265.learns_what: nothing; fixed contribution-function memory growth and path reorganization
2604.17265.unique: Grows fine-grained memory fragments from query seed tokens, retraces and refines them via a contribution function into a connected memory path.

2604.23626.name: GraphPlanner
2604.23626.what: A heterogeneous graph (GARNet) captures interaction memories among queries, agents and responses; an RL-optimized MDP selects backbone and agent role per step.
2604.23626.learns_what: routing MDP (backbone and agent-role selection) trained via RL over graph memory state
2604.23626.unique: RL-optimized MDP over heterogeneous GARNet jointly selects LLM backbone and agent role per routing step.

2604.08256.name: HyperMem
2604.08256.what: Hyperedges group related episodes and facts across three levels (topics, episodes, facts); a hybrid lexical-semantic index supports coarse-to-fine retrieval.
2604.08256.learns_what: nothing; fixed hypergraph structuring and coarse-to-fine hybrid index
2604.08256.unique: Hyperedges unify topics, episodes and facts into coherent units for coarse-to-fine hybrid lexical-semantic retrieval.

2604.01007.name: Omni-SimpleMem
2604.01007.what: An autonomous research pipeline runs ~50 experiments diagnosing failures and proposing architecture/prompt/data-pipeline changes to discover a unified multimodal lifelong memory framework.
2604.01007.learns_what: nothing at deployment; final architecture discovered offline by an autonomous research pipeline
2604.01007.unique: Autonomous research pipeline runs ~50 experiments to discover the memory architecture itself rather than proposing one.

2604.27707.name: Memo vs True Memory
2604.27707.what: Argues vector-store/RAG/scratchpad systems implement lookup, not memory, and proposes pairing fast episodic storage with slow weight consolidation per Complementary Learning Systems theory.
2604.27707.unique: Argues retrieval is lookup not memory, proposes pairing episodic storage with weight consolidation per CLS theory.

2604.04503.name: MIA
2604.04503.what: Manager stores compressed historical search trajectories (non-parametric); Planner is a parametric memory agent with a bidirectional parametric/non-parametric conversion loop.
2604.04503.learns_what: Planner/Executor trained via RL; Planner keeps updating online via param/non-param memory loop
2604.04503.unique: A bidirectional parametric/non-parametric conversion loop lets the Planner keep evolving online via alternating RL.

2604.08000.name: Pask
2604.08000.what: Hybrid memory across workspace, user and global scopes feeds a streaming IntentFlow model that infers latent user intent for proactive intervention.
2604.08000.fit: Hybrid workspace/user/global stores resemble tiers more than a single form; low confidence on exact write/read mechanism from the abstract.
2604.08000.learns_what: IntentFlow model trained to infer latent user intent from streaming context and hybrid memory
2604.08000.unique: Feeds workspace/user/global hybrid memory into a streaming IntentFlow model that infers latent user intent for proactive action.

2604.13018.name: AiScientist
2604.13018.what: A File-as-Bus workspace preserves decision-relevant artifacts across roles and repeated rounds of one long-horizon ML research task, without persisting beyond it.
2604.13018.learns_what: nothing; fixed File-as-Bus workspace preserves state within one long task
2604.13018.unique: File-as-Bus workspace preserves decision-relevant artefacts across roles and rounds of one long-horizon ML research task.

2604.18002.name: Neural Garbage Collection

2510.18866.unique: Decouples online interaction from offline sleep-time long-term consolidation, cutting token cost up to 38x.

2510.16392.name: RGMem
2510.16392.what: Renormalization-group-inspired multi-scale evolution turns episodic interactions into semantic facts and insights, integrated via hierarchical coarse-graining and rescaling into a user profile.
2510.16392.learns_what: nothing; fixed multi-scale coarse-graining evolves a user profile
2510.16392.unique: Uses renormalization-group coarse-graining and thresholded rescaling to separate fast facts from slow-varying user traits.

2512.04763.name: MemLoRA
2512.04763.what: Distills separate LoRA memory adapters for knowledge extraction, update and memory-augmented generation, enabling on-device small models to match much larger LLMs.
2512.04763.learns_what: LoRA memory adapters for extraction/update/generation via knowledge distillation
2512.04763.unique: Distills separate LoRA adapters per memory operation (extract/update/generate) so small on-device models match larger LLMs.

2510.02375.name: Hierarchical Parametric Memory
2510.02375.what: A small model fetches a context-dependent block from a large hierarchical parametric memory bank during pretraining and inference to store long-tail knowledge.
2510.02375.learns_what: hierarchical parametric memory bank storing long-tail knowledge, learned in pretraining
2510.02375.unique: Small model fetches a context-dependent block from a large hierarchical memory bank for long-tail knowledge.

2509.17459.name: PRINCIPLES
2509.17459.what: Offline self-play simulations distill a synthetic strategy memory of reusable dialogue tactics, retrieved to guide proactive strategy planning at inference without training.
2509.17459.learns_what: synthetic strategy memory distilled from offline self-play simulations
2509.17459.unique: Offline self-play simulations distill a synthetic strategy memory of dialogue tactics, used without any further training.

2510.08191.name: Training-Free GRPO
2510.08191.what: Distills group-relative semantic advantages from rollouts into a token-prior of experiential knowledge, injected at API-call time instead of updating weights.
2510.08191.learns_what: token-prior experiential knowledge distilled from group-relative rollout comparisons
2510.08191.unique: Distills group-relative semantic advantages from rollouts into a token-prior injected at API-call time, no weight updates.

2510.06664.name: ToolMem
2510.06664.what: Summarizes tool strengths/weaknesses from past interactions into memory entries, retrieved to predict tool performance and select the best tool per task.
2510.06664.learns_what: tool capability memory (strengths/weaknesses) summarized from past interactions
2510.06664.unique: Summarizes each tool's strengths/weaknesses from past interactions to predict performance and select the best tool.

2509.12810.name: H2R
2509.12810.what: Hierarchical Hindsight Reflection distills separate high-level planning and low-level execution memories from past trajectories, retrieved independently at test time.
2509.12810.learns_what: hierarchical planning/execution memory distilled via hindsight reflection
2509.12810.unique: Distills separate high-level planning and low-level execution memories via hindsight reflection, retrieved independently at test time.

2510.10666.name: BrowserAgent
2510.10666.what: Operates raw web pages via Playwright browser actions; an explicit memory mechanism stores key conclusions across steps to aid long-horizon reasoning.
2510.10666.learns_what: web-browsing action policy via supervised plus rejection fine-tuning
2510.10666.unique: Operates raw web pages via Playwright browser actions with an explicit memory storing key conclusions across steps.

2510.04851.name: LEGOMem
2510.04851.what: Decomposes past task trajectories into reusable procedural memory units allocated across orchestrator and task agents for planning and execution.
2510.04851.learns_what: reusable procedural memory units decomposed from past task trajectories
2510.04851.unique: Decomposes trajectories into reusable procedural memory units flexibly allocated between orchestrator and task agents.

2510.23601.name: Alita-G
2510.23601.what: Synthesizes MCP tools from successful trajectories, abstracts them into parameterized primitives stored in an MCP Box, retrieved via description-based selection at inference.
2510.23601.learns_what: reusable MCP tools synthesized and abstracted from successful trajectories
2510.23601.unique: Synthesizes MCP tools from successful trajectories and abstracts them into parameterized primitives stored in an MCP Box.

2510.08558.name: Early Experience
2510.08558.what: The agent's own interaction data (without rewards) trains implicit world models grounding policy in dynamics, and self-reflection on suboptimal actions improves reasoning.
2510.08558.learns_what: policy trained on self-generated, reward-free interaction data and reflections
2510.08558.unique: Trains on reward-free self-generated states for implicit world modeling plus reflection on suboptimal actions.

2509.13310.name: AgentFounder
2509.13310.what: Agentic Continual Pre-training builds an agentic foundation model before post-training, resolving the optimization tension between learning agentic behaviors and aligning to demonstrations.
2509.13310.learns_what: agentic foundation model weights via continual pretraining on agentic data
2509.13310.unique: Agentic continual pretraining builds a foundation model before post-training, resolving behavior-vs-alignment optimization tension.

2510.24699.name: AgentFold
2510.24699.what: Learns a 'folding' operation that performs granular condensation or deep consolidation of trajectory history at multiple scales instead of fixed summarization.
2510.24699.unique: Learns a multi-scale 'folding' operation: granular condensation for fine details or deep consolidation abstracting entire sub-tasks.

2509.22315.name: PRIME
2509.22315.what: A fast System-1 agent answers first; if uncertain, it triggers a System-2 pipeline of planning, hypothesis, retrieval and integration agents for deliberate reasoning.

2506.03141.name: Context-as-Memory
2506.03141.what: Stores historical video frames directly as context; a Memory Retrieval module selects FOV-overlapping relevant frames to condition scene-consistent video generation.
2506.03141.learns_what: video generator conditioned on retrieved historical context frames
2506.03141.unique: Stores raw frames as context directly; a Memory Retrieval module selects frames by camera FOV overlap.

2510.21618.name: DeepAgent
2510.21618.what: An autonomous memory-folding mechanism compresses past interactions into structured episodic, working and tool memories during a single coherent reasoning process, trained via ToolPO RL.
2510.21618.learns_what: tool-use/reasoning policy and memory-folding trained end-to-end via RL (ToolPO)
2510.21618.unique: Autonomous memory-folding compresses past interactions into structured episodic, working, and tool memories within one reasoning process.

2510.00615.name: ACON
2510.00615.what: Iteratively refines natural-language compression guidelines from agent failure analysis to compress observations and history; the compressor is distilled into smaller models.
2510.00615.learns_what: natural-language compression guidelines refined from agent failure analysis
2510.00615.unique: Iteratively refines natural-language compression guidelines from agent failure analysis, then distills the compressor into smaller models.

2510.27246.name: BEAM / LIGHT
2510.27246.what: BEAM benchmark auto-generates up to 10M-token coherent conversations with probing questions; LIGHT equips LLMs with episodic memory, working memory and a scratchpad.
2510.27246.unique: Auto-generates up to 10M-token conversations; LIGHT adds episodic memory, working memory and a scratchpad.

2510.23981.name: TeleEgo
2510.23981.what: Streaming omni-modal benchmark of 14+ hours per participant tests memory recall, understanding and cross-memory reasoning via Real-Time Accuracy and Memory Persistence Time.
2510.23981.unique: 14+ hours/participant streaming omni-modal data; introduces Real-Time Accuracy and Memory Persistence Time metrics.

2510.17281.name: MemoryBench
2510.17281.what: A user-feedback simulation framework and benchmark evaluate continual learning from accumulated service-time feedback across multiple domains, languages and task types.
2510.17281.unique: User-feedback simulation framework evaluates continual learning from accumulated service-time feedback across domains.

2510.07713.name: MemWeaver
2510.07713.what: Weaves user textual history into hierarchical behavioral memory (specific actions) and cognitive memory (long-term preferences), capturing temporal and semantic structure.
2510.07713.learns_what: nothing; fixed pipeline builds behavioral and cognitive memory layers
2510.07713.unique: Builds parallel behavioral (actions) and cognitive (preferences) memories capturing both temporal and semantic structure.

2510.23730.name: LTM Evaluation Study
2510.23730.what: Systematically compares full-context prompting, RAG, agentic memory, episodic in-context learning and procedural prompt optimization on annotated long-context dialogue QA.
2510.23730.unique: Systematically compares full-context, RAG, agentic, episodic and procedural memory on annotated dialogue QA.

2510.24168.name: MGA
2510.24168.what: An Observer reads screen state task-agnostically; a Structured Memory distills, validates and compresses each step into verified state deltas forming a lightweight transition chain.
2510.24168.learns_what: nothing; fixed observer and structured-memory pipeline for GUI state deltas
2510.24168.unique: Observer reads screen state task-agnostically; Structured Memory distills each step into verified state deltas forming a transition chain.

2510.01784.name: MemoryPack
2510.01784.what: A learnable context-retrieval mechanism uses textual and image global guidance to jointly model short- and long-term dependencies for minute-level video consistency.
2510.01784.learns_what: learnable context-retrieval memory mechanism trained with the video model
2510.01784.unique: Learnable context-retrieval mechanism jointly models short- and long-term dependencies via text and image guidance.

2510.08203.name: Function Token Hypothesis
2510.08203.what: Proposes function tokens activate predictive context features governing next-token retrieval at inference, and drive parameter updates (consolidation) during pretraining.

2510.16079.name: EvolveR
2510.16079.what: Offline self-distillation synthesizes interaction trajectories into reusable strategic principles; online interaction retrieves and applies them, updated via policy reinforcement.
2510.16079.learns_what: agent policy updated via RL, guided by distilled strategic principles
2510.16079.unique: Offline self-distillation synthesizes strategic principles retrieved online, updated via a policy reinforcement mechanism.

2510.08002.name: MUSE
2510.08002.what: A hierarchical Memory Module organizes levels of experience; after each sub-task the agent reflects and integrates structured experience back into memory for self-evolution.
2510.08002.learns_what: hierarchical memory module updated via post-task reflection into structured experience
2510.08002.unique: A hierarchical Memory Module organizes levels of experience; agent reflects post-sub-task to integrate structured experience.

2510.07915.name: MARC
2510.07915.what: A Visual Memory Retriever selects key video clips via a retrieve-then-compress strategy; RL-based Compression GRPO distills reasoning from teacher to student for token compression.
2510.07915.learns_what: student token-compression policy distilled from teacher via RL (C-GRPO)
2510.07915.unique: Visual Memory Retriever selects key clips; RL-based Compression GRPO distills reasoning from teacher to student.

2510.15103.name: Sparse Memory Finetuning
2510.15103.what: Fine-tunes only highly-activated memory-layer slots on new facts, sharply reducing catastrophic forgetting versus full finetuning or LoRA.
2510.15103.learns_what: sparsely fine-tunes memory-layer slots highly activated by new facts
2510.15103.unique: Fine-tunes only highly-activated memory-layer slots per new fact, cutting forgetting from 89% to 11%.

2510.03611.name: LLM Graph Induction Memory Drift
2510.03611.what: Evaluates LLMs on inducing structured graphs from noisy long text, showing memory drift and forgetting at shorter lengths than needle-in-haystack tests suggest.
2510.03611.unique: Tasks LLMs with inducing structured graphs from noisy long text, showing drift at shorter lengths than needle tests.

2510.13614.name: MemoTime
2510.13614.what: Decomposes temporal questions into a Tree of Time over a temporal knowledge graph; a self-evolving experience memory stores verified reasoning traces for reuse.
2510.13614.learns_what: self-evolving experience memory of verified reasoning traces and toolkit decisions
2510.13614.unique: Decomposes questions into a hierarchical Tree of Time over a temporal KG with reusable experience memory.

2510.10397.name: AssoMem
2510.10397.what: Builds an associative memory graph linking dialogue utterances to extracted clues; retrieval fuses relevance, importance and temporal signals via mutual-information weighting.
2510.10397.learns_what: nothing; fixed associative graph with mutual-information-driven retrieval fusion
2510.10397.unique: Anchors utterances to extracted clues; fuses relevance, importance and temporal signals via mutual-information weighting.

2510.08601.name: Mnemosyne
2510.08601.what: Stores dialogue in a graph with substance/redundancy filters and pruning; retrieval uses probabilistic recall with temporal decay and a derived core summary.
2510.08601.learns_what: nothing; fixed unsupervised graph storage, pruning and decay-based recall
2510.08601.unique: Uses probabilistic recall with temporal decay/refresh and a derived core summary from the memory graph.

2510.12422.name: VideoLucy
2510.12422.what: Uses a hierarchical, progressively finer memory structure over video frames and an agent-based iterative backtracking loop to mine question-relevant deep memories.
2510.12422.learns_what: nothing; fixed hierarchical backtracking agent mines question-relevant video memories
2510.12422.unique: Coarse-to-fine hierarchical memory mined via an iterative agent-based backtracking loop until confident.

2510.00444.name: TokMem
2510.00444.what: Compiles each reusable task procedure into a single trainable memory token that indexes and steers generation, keeping the backbone LLM frozen.
2510.00444.learns_what: trainable memory tokens (one per procedure) that index and steer generation
2510.00444.unique: Compiles each reusable procedure into one trainable memory token that indexes and steers generation.

2509.25911.name: Mem-α
2509.25911.what: RL trains an agent to extract, structure and update a memory system with core, episodic and semantic components, rewarded by downstream QA accuracy.
2509.25911.learns_what: memory construction/update policy trained via RL from downstream QA reward
2509.25911.unique: RL-trains an agent, rewarded by downstream QA accuracy, to decide what to extract, structure, and update.

2509.21212.name: SGMem
2509.21212.what: Represents dialogue as sentence-level graphs within chunked units capturing turn/round/session links; retrieval combines raw dialogue with generated summaries, facts and insights.
2509.21212.learns_what: nothing; fixed sentence-graph construction combining raw dialogue and generated memory
2509.21212.unique: Sentence-level graphs within chunks capture turn/round/session links, combined with generated summaries, facts and insights.

2508.03341.name: Nemori
2508.03341.what: Episodic Memory Integration turns raw interactions into coherent narratives; Semantic Knowledge Distillation extracts insights by measuring prediction error, rather than fixed heuristics.
2508.03341.learns_what: nothing; narratives and insights distilled via a prediction-error signal, not learned
2508.03341.unique: Extracts semantic insights using a prediction-error signal instead of fixed heuristics like importance scores or tags.

2509.11860.name: MOOM
2509.11860.what: Dual-branch memory plugin summarizes plot conflicts across multiple time scales in one branch and extracts a user character profile in the other, with a forgetting mechanism.
2509.11860.learns_what: nothing; fixed dual-branch plot/profile memory with competition-inhibition forgetting
2509.11860.unique: Dual branches track multi-scale plot conflicts and character profile, with competition-inhibition forgetting to cap growth.

2508.15294.name: Multiple Memory Systems (MMS)
2508.15294.what: Splits short-term memory into paired retrieval memory units and contextual memory units; a query matches a retrieval unit and fetches its corresponding context unit.
2508.15294.learns_what: nothing; fixed multi-segment retrieval and contextual memory units
2508.15294.unique: Splits memory into paired retrieval units and contextual units; a query matches a retrieval unit then fetches its paired context unit.

2508.12630.name: Semantic Anchoring
2508.12630.what: Enriches vector-based dialogue memory with dependency parsing, discourse-relation tagging and coreference resolution to create structured, linked memory entries.
2508.12630.learns_what: nothing; fixed linguistic parsing (dependency/discourse/coreference) creates structured memory entries
2508.12630.unique: Enriches vector memory with dependency parsing, discourse-relation tagging and coreference resolution links.

2508.10419.name: ComoRAG
2508.10419.what: On a reasoning impasse, generates probing queries, retrieves new evidence into a dynamic global memory pool, and iterates cycles until the narrative query resolves.
2508.10419.learns_what: nothing; prompted LLM iterates probing queries into a memory pool
2508.10419.unique: On a reasoning impasse, generates probing queries and integrates newly retrieved evidence into a dynamic global memory pool across cycles.

2509.25140.name: ReasoningBank
2509.25140.what: Distills generalizable reasoning strategies from an agent's self-judged successful and failed trajectories; retrieves relevant memories to guide new tasks and updates the bank afterward.
2509.25140.learns_what: reusable reasoning strategies distilled from successful/failed trajectories
2509.25140.unique: Distills strategies from self-judged success/failure and scales learning via memory-aware test-time scaling (MaTTS).

2508.16153.name: Memento
2508.16153.what: Stores past trajectories in an episodic memory used by a case-selection policy; memory is rewritten from feedback and read at inference, with no LLM gradient updates.
2508.16153.learns_what: case-selection policy over episodic memory, trained via online RL
2508.16153.unique: A memory-augmented MDP with a neural case-selection policy trained via online RL over episodic memory.

2509.13313.name: ReSum
2509.13313.what: Periodically invokes an external tool to condense a web agent's interaction history into compact summaries, enabling unbounded exploration within a fixed context window.
2509.13313.learns_what: policy for reasoning over summarized context, trained with GRPO
2509.13313.unique: Periodically invokes an external tool to condense web-agent interaction history into compact summaries, enabling unbounded exploration.

2509.24704.name: MemGen
2509.24704.what: A memory trigger monitors reasoning state to invoke memory; a memory weaver generates a latent token sequence as machine-native memory woven into ongoing reasoning.
2509.24704.learns_what: memory weaver generating latent tokens woven into reasoning
2509.24704.unique: A memory trigger monitors reasoning state to invoke a weaver that generates latent tokens woven into ongoing reasoning.

2508.15253.name: CARE
2508.15253.what: A context assessor encodes raw retrieved passages into compact memory token embeddings, trained via grounded/adversarial soft prompting to flag unreliable RAG context.
2508.15253.learns_what: context assessor embeddings trained to flag unreliable RAG context
2508.15253.unique: Context assessor trained via grounded/adversarial soft prompting to flag unreliable retrieved passages in RAG.

2508.19236.name: MemoryVLA
2508.19236.what: A VLM encodes observations into working-memory tokens; a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank stores and consolidates low-level and semantic details, retrieved to condition a diffusion action expert.
2508.19236.learns_what: perceptual-cognitive memory bank and action expert trained on demonstrations
2508.19236.unique: Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank consolidates low-level detail and semantics, fused to condition a diffusion action expert.

2509.17158.name: ARE / Gaia2
2509.17158.what: A research platform for building diverse agent environments; Gaia2 benchmark requires agents to handle ambiguity, dynamic environments, collaboration and temporal constraints asynchronously.
2509.17158.unique: Asynchronous platform surfacing ambiguity, collaboration and temporal-constraint failures invisible in static settings.

2509.11145.name: Text2Mem
2509.11145.what: Defines a formal, executable operation language (JSON schema, validator, backend adapters) covering encode/retrieve/delete plus merge/promote/demote/split/lock/expire commands for memory systems.
2509.11145.unique: Defines a formal, executable operation language (JSON schema, validator, backend adapters) covering encode/retrieve/delete plus merge/promote/demote/split/lock/expire commands for memory systems.

2509.09498.name: SEDM
2509.09498.what: Verifiable write admission via reproducible replay, a self-scheduling controller that ranks/consolidates memory entries by utility, and cross-domain diffusion of reusable insights.
2509.09498.learns_what: memory admission/ranking policy and cross-domain reusable insights
2509.09498.unique: Admits memory writes via reproducible replay and diffuses reusable insights across domains through a self-scheduling controller.

2509.26391.name: MotionRAG
2509.26391.what: Retrieves high-level motion features from reference videos via a video encoder/resamplers and injects adapted motion priors into pretrained video diffusion models.
2509.26391.learns_what: motion adaptation module (causal transformer, injection adapter)
2509.26391.unique: Retrieves high-level motion features from a reference-video database and adapts priors via an in-context causal transformer.

2509.01092.name: REFRAG
2509.01092.what: Exploits block-diagonal attention over RAG's concatenated passages to compress, sense and selectively expand the KV cache, cutting decoding latency without perplexity loss.
2509.01092.learns_what: learned compression/expansion of KV cache over RAG context
2509.01092.unique: Exploits RAG's block-diagonal attention to learn compress/sense/expand of KV cache, 30x TTFT speedup.

2509.16189.name: Latent Learning (episodic memory)
2509.16189.what: Argues an oracle retrieval mechanism over stored past experiences lets agents flexibly reuse task-irrelevant learned information for later generalization, unlike purely parametric learning.
2509.16189.learns_what: nothing; oracle retrieval reuses stored past experiences in-context
2509.16189.unique: Argues an oracle retrieval mechanism over past experiences lets agents flexibly reuse task-irrelevant learned information for generalization.

2509.25250.name: Low-Code Agent Memory Management
2509.25250.what: Hybrid episodic+semantic memory with an Intelligent Decay mechanism that prunes or consolidates entries by a composite recency/relevance/utility score, with user visualization/tagging.
2509.25250.learns_what: nothing; fixed decay heuristic prunes/consolidates memory by score
2509.25250.unique: Intelligent Decay mechanism prunes/consolidates episodic and semantic memory by composite recency/relevance/utility score, with user tagging.

2508.19005.name: ELL / StuLife
2508.19005.what: Framework combining experience exploration, structured long-term memory, autonomous skill abstraction from recurring patterns, and internalization of experience into implicit capability; StuLife benchmark simulates a student's college journey.
2508.19005.learns_what: reusable skills abstracted from trajectories, later internalized
2508.19005.unique: Four-stage framework internalizes explicit experience into implicit capability as second nature, with a StuLife benchmark.

2508.09736.name: M3-Agent
2508.09736.what: Builds entity-centric episodic and semantic memories from real-time video and audio; multi-turn reasoning retrieves relevant memories, trained via reinforcement learning. M3-Bench evaluates it.
2508.09736.learns_what: multi-turn retrieval/reasoning policy over multimodal memory, trained via RL
2508.09736.unique: Entity-centric episodic/semantic memory with RL-trained multi-turn reasoning retrieval, evaluated on new M3-Bench.

2508.19828.name: Memory-R1
2508.19828.what: RL-trained Memory Manager issues ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP operations on an external memory bank; a separately trained Answer Agent pre-selects and reasons over relevant entries.
2508.19828.learns_what: memory ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP policy and answer-selection policy
2508.19828.unique: RL-trained Memory Manager issues ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP ops on a memory bank; a separate RL Answer Agent pre-selects and reasons over entries.

2508.08997.name: Intrinsic Memory Agents
2508.08997.what: Each multi-agent role keeps a memory that evolves intrinsically with its own outputs, using a generic template to preserve role-aligned, task-relevant information.
2508.08997.learns_what: nothing; role-aligned memory grows from agent's own outputs via template
2508.08997.unique: Each multi-agent role keeps memory that evolves intrinsically with its own outputs, using a generic template to preserve role-aligned context.

2508.09874.name: Memory Decoder
2508.09874.what: A small pretrained transformer decoder imitates an external kNN retriever's behavior; it plugs into any model sharing its tokenizer without further training.
2508.09874.learns_what: decoder pretrained to imitate an external kNN retriever's behavior
2508.09874.unique: Small pretrained decoder imitates an external kNN retriever, plugging into any model sharing its tokenizer.

2508.01832.name: MLP Memory
2508.01832.what: An MLP pretrained to imitate a kNN retriever over the whole pretraining corpus is fused with the transformer decoder via probability interpolation.
2508.01832.learns_what: MLP pretrained to imitate a kNN retriever over pretraining corpus
2508.01832.unique: MLP pretrained to imitate a kNN retriever fused with the decoder via probability interpolation.

2505.17670.name: CoMEM
2505.17670.what: Fine-tunes a VLM to encode arbitrary multimodal/multilingual knowledge into just 8 continuous dense embeddings that serve as compact memory read by the frozen inference-time VLM.
2505.17670.learns_what: VLM fine-tuned to encode knowledge into 8 continuous memory embeddings
2505.17670.unique: VLM fine-tuned as its own encoder to compress multimodal/multilingual knowledge into just 8 continuous embeddings.

2508.06433.name: Memp
2508.06433.what: Distills past agent trajectories into fine-grained step-by-step instructions and higher-level script abstractions, with a repository dynamically built, retrieved from and updated.
2508.06433.learns_what: procedural memory (step instructions, script abstractions) built from trajectories
2508.06433.unique: Systematically explores Build/Retrieval/Update strategies for procedural memory; memory built by a stronger model transfers to weaker ones.

2508.04700.name: SEAgent
2508.04700.what: Agent explores unfamiliar software and updates policy weights via adversarial imitation of failures plus GRPO on successes, guided by a World State Model and Curriculum Generator.
2508.04700.learns_what: CUA policy weights updated via GRPO and adversarial imitation of failures
2508.04700.unique: World State Model and Curriculum Generator drive adversarial imitation of failures plus GRPO on successes.

2508.04664.name: Sculptor
2508.04664.what: Gives LLMs tools for context fragmentation, summarize/hide/restore, and precise search to actively manage their own working memory, further tuned with RL.
2508.04664.learns_what: tool-based context fragmentation/summarize/hide/restore; RL further tunes it
2508.04664.unique: Equips LLMs with tools for context fragmentation, summarize/hide/restore, and precise search to actively sculpt their own working memory.

2508.09124.name: OdysseyBench
2508.09124.what: Benchmark of long-horizon office workflows (Word, Excel, PDF, Email, Calendar) requiring agents to identify essential information from long interaction histories across apps.
2508.09124.unique: HomerAgents auto-generates long-horizon office workflows spanning Word, Excel, PDF, Email and Calendar.

2508.17330.name: Omne-R1
2508.17330.what: Multi-stage RL and SFT training over auto-generated QA on schema-free knowledge graphs to improve multi-hop question answering, especially 3+ hop questions.
2508.17330.learns_what: multi-hop KG reasoning policy trained via two RL phases plus SFT
2508.17330.unique: Two RL phases plus SFT train multi-hop reasoning over schema-free KGs from auto-generated QA.

2508.09486.name: Video-EM
2508.09486.what: An LLM agent localizes query-relevant moments, groups them into temporally coherent events with timestamps and entities, then self-reflects to prune redundancy for video QA.
2508.09486.learns_what: nothing; LLM agent orchestrates tools to build/refine episodic event timeline
2508.09486.unique: LLM agent groups localized moments into a timestamped event timeline, then self-reflects to prune redundancy.

2508.21058.name: Mixture of Contexts (MoC)
2508.21058.what: A learnable sparse attention routing module lets each query dynamically select informative chunks plus mandatory anchors as an internal retrieval engine across minutes-long video generation.
2508.21058.learns_what: sparse attention routing module (long-term memory retrieval) learned in training
2508.21058.unique: Learnable sparse routing lets each query select informative chunks plus mandatory anchors as an internal retrieval engine.

2508.12379.name: GraphCogent
2508.12379.what: Decomposes graph reasoning into Sensory (subgraph sampling), Buffer (indexes graph data across formats), and Execution modules modeled on human working memory to overcome context limits.
2508.12379.learns_what: nothing; fixed sense-buffer-execute pipeline decomposes graph reasoning
2508.12379.unique: Decomposes graph reasoning into Sensory (subgraph sampling), Buffer (multi-format graph indexing), and Execution modules.

2508.13250.name: Explicit vs Implicit Memory / HybridMem
2508.13250.what: Defines a multi-hop personalized reasoning task and dataset, evaluates explicit and implicit memory methods, and proposes HybridMem combining both paradigms.
2508.13250.unique: Defines a multi-hop personalized reasoning task; HybridMem combines explicit and implicit memory methods.

2507.07957.name: MIRIX
2507.07957.what: Six coordinated memory types (Core, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Resource, Knowledge Vault) managed by a multi-agent framework; handles text and screenshots for long-term recall.
2507.07957.learns_what: nothing; multi-agent framework coordinates updates/retrieval over structured memory
2507.07957.unique: Coordinates six distinct memory types (Core, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Resource, Knowledge Vault) via a dedicated multi-agent framework.

2507.22925.name: H-MEM
